item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "f8c97b1b07cd3eaaf61657f40aae3c79098868c5bb8816a8c3c60497892ebdb8",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {"id":"D001","name":"LocalDef001","meaning":"Multiplies a line rule's output by the product of cell widths transverse to d.","effect_on_target":"The Cartesian specialization assumes rule(d,c,h,l)=A_d(c) lineRule(d,c,h,l).","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D002","name":"LocalDef002","meaning":"The box of real coordinate vectors x satisfying left_d(c_d) ≤ x_d < right_d(c_d) for every d.","effect_on_target":"Defines the Cartesian cell whose product Lebesgue measure is compared with data.cellVolume.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D003","name":"LocalDef003","meaning":"The product over all directions of the corresponding cell widths.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the conditional Cartesian factorization of cell volume.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D004","name":"LocalDef004","meaning":"The product of cell widths over all directions other than d; an empty product is 1.","effect_on_target":"Defines transverse area in face measures, rule scaling, and the lifted balance.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D005","name":"LocalDef005","meaning":"The half-open product box indexed by directions e unequal to d.","effect_on_target":"Its measure is taken in the transverse coordinate space, not in the full coordinate space.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D006","name":"LocalDef006","meaning":"Updates each cell value by subtracting time step divided by cell volume times the numerical outgoing-minus-incoming flux.","effect_on_target":"Defines each directional stage and all update identities.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D007","name":"LocalDef007","meaning":"Numerical flux at c[d:=c_d+1] minus numerical flux at c.","effect_on_target":"Fixes the sign and adjacent-face indexing of the update.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D008","name":"LocalDef008","meaning":"Evaluates rule at a direction, right-hand cell index, time step, and the entire state line through that cell.","effect_on_target":"Each numerical face output depends on the state only along its coordinate line.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D009","name":"LocalDef009","meaning":"Applies directional updates in the order of the supplied stage list, starting from the supplied state.","effect_on_target":"Determines prefix states and the full sequential evolution.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D010","name":"LocalDef010","meaning":"Every physical face flux is time-interval integrable, and each volume-weighted mean change equals the time integral of incoming minus outgoing physical flux.","effect_on_target":"Defines both reference balance and the final lifted one-dimensional balance.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D011","name":"LocalDef011","meaning":"A data structure containing the partition, measure, finite positive cell measures, face measures and points, admissible sets, normal fluxes, and the constraints specified by D029.","effect_on_target":"Several geometric and differentiability assumptions are carried by data rather than separately listed hypotheses.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D012","name":"LocalDef012","meaning":"On the closed interval between s and t, requires cell integrability of q, integrability of its sampled normal flux, admissible face and domain values, and the directional integral balance D010.","effect_on_target":"The stage references are assumed to satisfy a full integral balance on [0,dt].","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D013","name":"LocalDef013","meaning":"Projects the direction-dependent admissible subset of the real state space.","effect_on_target":"Restricts derivative claims, constant-state consistency, stage states, and reference values.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D014","name":"LocalDef014","meaning":"The integral of q over a cell at a fixed time divided by that cell's real measure.","effect_on_target":"Defines the reference means in the error assumptions and conclusion.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D015","name":"LocalDef015","meaning":"The real conversion of the measure of a cell region.","effect_on_target":"Provides positive finite update denominators through the constraints in D029.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D016","name":"LocalDef016","meaning":"Integrates the normal flux of q sampled at face points with respect to the specified face measure.","effect_on_target":"Defines the physical reference face flux.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D017","name":"LocalDef017","meaning":"Projects the measure on FacePoint for a direction and cell.","effect_on_target":"Determines integration of constant and reference face fluxes.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D018","name":"LocalDef018","meaning":"Projects the vector-valued normal flux function of direction, cell, face point, and state.","effect_on_target":"Its state derivative must have a real eigenbasis on the admissible set.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D019","name":"LocalDef019","meaning":"The time average of the physical face flux between s and t.","effect_on_target":"The face-error assumption compares numerical flux with a time average, not a time integral alone.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D020","name":"LocalDef020","meaning":"At every state in the given set, the flux has a Fréchet derivative whose matrix has a basis of real eigenvectors.","effect_on_target":"The first substantive conclusion repeats this property stored in data.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D021","name":"LocalDef021","meaning":"q is integrable on every finite spatial interval at each time; flux(q) is integrable on every finite time interval at each location; every space-time rectangle satisfies the integral conservation identity.","effect_on_target":"Provides the hypothesis for lifting one-dimensional integral conservation to Cartesian cells.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D022","name":"LocalDef022","meaning":"An integer-indexed family of positive-length adjacent real intervals, as specified by D035.","effect_on_target":"Defines allowable axis grids in the conditional specialization.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D023","name":"LocalDef023","meaning":"Projects the left endpoint of an axis cell.","effect_on_target":"The lifted physical flux is sampled at that endpoint.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D024","name":"LocalDef024","meaning":"The oriented integral over an axis cell divided by its positive width.","effect_on_target":"Defines the lifted one-dimensional cell mean.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D025","name":"LocalDef025","meaning":"The one-dimensional update u_i minus dt/width_i times (edgeFlux_{i+1} minus edgeFlux_i).","effect_on_target":"The Cartesian directional update restricted to a line equals this update.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D026","name":"LocalDef026","meaning":"Projects the measurable cell partition from data.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the regions and domain used in reference assumptions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D027","name":"LocalDef027","meaning":"Projects the map from an abstract face point to a spatial point.","effect_on_target":"Determines where q is sampled; D029 constrains these points to adjacent closures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D028","name":"LocalDef028","meaning":"Projects the measure on Point.","effect_on_target":"Determines cell volumes, integrability, and reference averages.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D029","name":"LocalDef029","meaning":"Constructs data from a measurable partition and measure with every cell measure nonzero and finite, face measures, face points lying in both adjacent cell closures, admissible sets, and normal fluxes satisfying D020.","effect_on_target":"Encodes positive cell volumes, face incidence, and statewise real diagonalizability as structural assumptions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D030","name":"LocalDef030","meaning":"Projects each cell's region from a partition.","effect_on_target":"Specifies the integration regions and adjacent closures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D031","name":"LocalDef031","meaning":"Projects the partition's domain.","effect_on_target":"Reference admissibility is required at every domain point.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D032","name":"LocalDef032","meaning":"There exists a continuous real-linear derivative at the state whose standard-coordinate matrix admits real eigenvalues and an eigenbasis.","effect_on_target":"Requires full ambient Fréchet differentiability, with witnesses allowed to depend on the state.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D033","name":"LocalDef033","meaning":"Projects the right endpoint of an axis cell.","effect_on_target":"Determines boxes, widths, and spatial averaging intervals.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D034","name":"LocalDef034","meaning":"Right endpoint minus left endpoint.","effect_on_target":"Defines each positive axis-cell width.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D035","name":"LocalDef035","meaning":"Constructs an axis grid with left_i < right_i and right_{i-1}=left_i for every integer i.","effect_on_target":"Requires adjacency and positive widths but no uniform spacing or exhaustion of the real line.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D036","name":"LocalDef036","meaning":"The restricted-measure integral of a field scaled by the inverse real measure of the region.","effect_on_target":"Cell averages are measure-normalized integrals.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D037","name":"LocalDef037","meaning":"oldAverage minus (timeStep/cellVolume) times netOutwardFlux.","effect_on_target":"Fixes the conservative update formula.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D038","name":"LocalDef038","meaning":"The oriented interval integral scaled by 1/(right-left), using totalized real inversion.","effect_on_target":"Defines time and spatial averages; relevant stage and grid denominators are positive.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D039","name":"LocalDef039","meaning":"Left-folds a list of state transformations, applying the first transformation first.","effect_on_target":"Fixes chronological stage composition.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D040","name":"LocalDef040","meaning":"A measurable partition structure with the fields and constraints in D044.","effect_on_target":"The spatial domain is exactly the union of pairwise disjoint measurable cell regions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D041","name":"LocalDef041","meaning":"The identity real ring homomorphism forms an inverse pair with itself.","effect_on_target":"Supports ordinary real-linear equivalences in derivative-to-matrix conversion.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D042","name":"LocalDef042","meaning":"The two real scalar actions on real coordinate vectors commute.","effect_on_target":"Supports the real module structure on linear maps; adds no state restriction.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D043","name":"LocalDef043","meaning":"There exist real eigenvalues indexed by the coordinate index type and a real basis such that each basis vector is an eigenvector with its corresponding eigenvalue.","effect_on_target":"Requires real diagonalizability, not distinct eigenvalues or an orthonormal eigenbasis.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D044","name":"LocalDef044","meaning":"Constructs a partition with an inhabited cell index type, measurable regions, pairwise disjoint distinct regions, and domain membership equivalent to membership in some region.","effect_on_target":"Encodes exact partition coverage and disjointness; positivity comes separately from data.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D045","name":"Algebra.id","meaning":"A commutative semiring acts on itself by multiplication with identity algebra map.","effect_on_target":"Real scalar multiplication on each state component is ordinary multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D046","name":"Algebra.toSMul","meaning":"Extracts scalar multiplication from an algebra.","effect_on_target":"Selects ordinary real scalar multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D047","name":"And","meaning":"Logical conjunction.","effect_on_target":"All listed conclusions hold simultaneously.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D048","name":"CommSemiring.toSemiring","meaning":"Forgets commutativity from a commutative semiring structure.","effect_on_target":"Preserves the real arithmetic used for scalar actions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D049","name":"DFunLike.coe","meaning":"Evaluates a function-like bundled object as its underlying function.","effect_on_target":"Allows measures to be evaluated on sets and bundled maps on arguments.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D050","name":"DecidableEq","meaning":"Equality of any two elements can be decided.","effect_on_target":"Enables coordinate replacement and deletion of a direction from finite products.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D051","name":"DivInvMonoid.toDiv","meaning":"Extracts division from a division-and-inversion structure.","effect_on_target":"Supplies real division in update coefficients.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D052","name":"ENNReal","meaning":"Nonnegative real numbers with an additional top element infinity.","effect_on_target":"Cell and face measures take extended nonnegative values.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D053","name":"ENNReal.toReal","meaning":"Converts finite nonnegative values to reals, with infinity converted to zero.","effect_on_target":"Actual cell measures are finite by data; Cartesian box measures are finite, so their real conversions are ordinary volumes.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D054","name":"Eq","meaning":"Equality of two objects of the same type.","effect_on_target":"Includes vector and entire-function equalities, as well as stage-list decompositions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D055","name":"Exists","meaning":"Existential quantification over the specified type.","effect_on_target":"Direction-covering time steps and derivative/eigenbasis witnesses may depend on preceding quantified parameters.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D056","name":"Fin","meaning":"The integers from 0 through m-1 represented as bounded natural numbers.","effect_on_target":"The state space has exactly m real coordinates.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D057","name":"Fin.fintype","meaning":"The finite enumeration of bounded natural indices.","effect_on_target":"Enables finite-dimensional norms, matrices, and coordinate bases.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D058","name":"Finset.range","meaning":"The finite set {0,...,n-1}.","effect_on_target":"Line-segment sums contain exactly count consecutive cells, including the empty case.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D059","name":"Finset.sum","meaning":"A finite commutative sum of the values of a function.","effect_on_target":"The conservation identity sums volume-weighted vectors componentwise.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D060","name":"Fintype","meaning":"A type equipped with a finite exhaustive enumeration.","effect_on_target":"D is finite; this alone does not require D to be inhabited.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D061","name":"Function.hasSMul","meaning":"Scalar multiplication of functions is pointwise.","effect_on_target":"All real scalings of state vectors act componentwise.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D062","name":"Function.update","meaning":"Replaces a function's value at one argument and preserves its other values.","effect_on_target":"c[d:=j] changes only the d-coordinate of a lattice cell.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D063","name":"HAdd.hAdd","meaning":"The selected addition operation.","effect_on_target":"Adds integer offsets and real error terms.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D064","name":"HAppend.hAppend","meaning":"The selected append operation.","effect_on_target":"Concatenates prefix and stage-plus-suffix lists.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D065","name":"HDiv.hDiv","meaning":"The selected division operation.","effect_on_target":"Forms time-step-to-volume ratios.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D066","name":"HMul.hMul","meaning":"The selected multiplication operation.","effect_on_target":"Multiplies real error coefficients.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D067","name":"HSMul.hSMul","meaning":"The selected scalar action.","effect_on_target":"Scales state and flux vectors by real numbers.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D068","name":"HSub.hSub","meaning":"The selected subtraction operation.","effect_on_target":"Forms state differences and oriented flux differences.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D069","name":"InnerProductSpace.toNormedSpace","meaning":"Extracts the normed vector-space structure from an inner-product space.","effect_on_target":"Provides the real scalar normed-space instance; it does not impose a Euclidean norm on the finite product.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D070","name":"Int","meaning":"The mathematical integers.","effect_on_target":"Cell coordinates, line locations, and starting indices range over all integers.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D071","name":"Int.instAdd","meaning":"Ordinary integer addition.","effect_on_target":"Defines neighboring indices and consecutive segment locations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D072","name":"LE.le","meaning":"The selected non-strict order relation.","effect_on_target":"Error estimates use the usual real ≤.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D073","name":"LT.lt","meaning":"The selected strict order relation.","effect_on_target":"Requires positive state dimension and positive stage durations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D074","name":"List","meaning":"Finite ordered sequences, allowing repetitions.","effect_on_target":"Stages have an order and directions may occur repeatedly.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D075","name":"List.cons","meaning":"Prepends one entry to a list.","effect_on_target":"Identifies the selected stage immediately after a prefix.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D076","name":"List.instAppend","meaning":"List concatenation.","effect_on_target":"Stage decompositions preserve prefix and suffix order.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D077","name":"List.instMembership","meaning":"An element occurs in a list.","effect_on_target":"Coverage requires an occurrence, without uniqueness.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D078","name":"List.nil","meaning":"The empty list.","effect_on_target":"The full stage list is required to differ from it.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D079","name":"MeasurableSpace","meaning":"A sigma-algebra of measurable subsets.","effect_on_target":"Point and FacePoint carry measurable structures; no compatibility with Point's topology is explicitly required.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D080","name":"MeasureTheory.Integrable","meaning":"Almost-everywhere strong measurability together with a finite integral of the norm.","effect_on_target":"Constant and reference flux integrability is substantive, not merely formal existence of integral expressions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D081","name":"MeasureTheory.Measure","meaning":"An extended nonnegative measure on a measurable space.","effect_on_target":"Allows arbitrary supplied spatial and face measures subject to the stated constraints.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D082","name":"MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike","meaning":"Evaluates a measure on a set using its underlying outer measure.","effect_on_target":"Interprets the cell and box measure expressions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D083","name":"MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.pi","meaning":"The finite product measurable space with product measure.","effect_on_target":"Cartesian cell and transverse face measures are products of real Lebesgue measures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D084","name":"MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.toMeasurableSpace","meaning":"Extracts the sigma-algebra from a space with a distinguished measure.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the product sigma-algebras for geometric volume claims.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D085","name":"MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume","meaning":"The distinguished measure of a measure space.","effect_on_target":"Means Lebesgue measure on reals and its finite products here.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D086","name":"MeasureTheory.integral","meaning":"The vector-valued Bochner integral; the supplied body is a wrapped implementation.","effect_on_target":"Integrates fluxes and means. Relevant analytic claims separately require integrability rather than deriving it from the integral notation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D087","name":"Membership.mem","meaning":"The membership relation selected for a collection.","effect_on_target":"Expresses set admissibility and list occurrence.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D088","name":"Nat","meaning":"The nonnegative integers.","effect_on_target":"m and count are natural numbers; only m is required positive.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D089","name":"Nat.cast","meaning":"Embeds natural numbers into the selected target type.","effect_on_target":"Segment counts and summation indices become integer coordinate offsets.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D090","name":"Ne","meaning":"Negation of equality.","effect_on_target":"Expresses nonempty lists, distinct directions or cells, and nonzero/noninfinite measures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D091","name":"NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring.toAddCommMonoid","meaning":"Extracts commutative addition and zero.","effect_on_target":"Provides the additive structure underlying real modules.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D092","name":"NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing","meaning":"Forgets multiplicative commutativity while retaining normed ring operations.","effect_on_target":"Preserves the real norm used in state-space constructions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D093","name":"NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup","meaning":"Retains the norm, additive group, and pseudometric from a seminormed ring.","effect_on_target":"Supplies componentwise additive normed structures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D094","name":"NonUnitalSemiring.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring","meaning":"Forgets associativity requirements from the bundled structure.","effect_on_target":"An instance conversion preserving ordinary real arithmetic.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D095","name":"Norm.norm","meaning":"The norm supplied by the chosen norm structure.","effect_on_target":"On states it is the maximum absolute coordinate, as established by D108.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D096","name":"NormedCommRing.toNormedRing","meaning":"Forgets multiplicative commutativity from a normed ring.","effect_on_target":"Preserves the absolute-value component norm.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D097","name":"NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing","meaning":"Retains norm and ring operations while weakening separation requirements.","effect_on_target":"Does not change the actual real norm.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D098","name":"NormedRing.toNorm","meaning":"Extracts a norm from a normed ring.","effect_on_target":"Selects the product norm in error inequalities.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D099","name":"NormedSpace.toModule","meaning":"Extracts the scalar module action from a normed space.","effect_on_target":"Uses ordinary real-linear scalar multiplication in updates.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D100","name":"OfNat.ofNat","meaning":"Interprets a natural numeral in the selected type.","effect_on_target":"The constants 0 and 1 retain their usual real, integer, or natural meanings.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D101","name":"Pi.Function.module","meaning":"The pointwise module structure on a function space.","effect_on_target":"State vectors form the real vector space of m-tuples.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D102","name":"Pi.addCommGroup","meaning":"Pointwise commutative group operations on functions.","effect_on_target":"Vector updates use coordinatewise addition and subtraction.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D103","name":"Pi.addCommMonoid","meaning":"Pointwise addition and zero on functions.","effect_on_target":"Finite vector sums are coordinatewise.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D104","name":"Pi.instSub","meaning":"(f-g)(i)=f(i)-g(i).","effect_on_target":"Every state and flux difference is componentwise.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D105","name":"Pi.normedAddCommGroup","meaning":"The finite product normed additive group using the product supremum norm.","effect_on_target":"Provides the state-space norm for integration.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D106","name":"Pi.normedRing","meaning":"The finite product normed ring with pointwise operations and supremum norm.","effect_on_target":"Error estimates use the maximum norm, not the Euclidean norm.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D107","name":"Pi.normedSpace","meaning":"Pointwise scalar multiplication compatible with the finite product norm.","effect_on_target":"Provides a real normed vector space for derivatives and integrals.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D108","name":"Pi.seminormedAddGroup","meaning":"The norm is the finite supremum of the nonnegative component norms.","effect_on_target":"For m>0, ||v||=max_{0≤i<m}|v_i|.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D109","name":"Pi.topologicalSpace","meaning":"The product topology induced by all coordinate projections.","effect_on_target":"State-space topology is the usual finite-dimensional product topology.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D110","name":"Prod","meaning":"The Cartesian product of two types.","effect_on_target":"A stage consists of a direction and a real duration.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D111","name":"Prod.mk","meaning":"Constructs an ordered pair.","effect_on_target":"Forms the stage (d,dt).","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D112","name":"Prod.snd","meaning":"The second component of a pair.","effect_on_target":"Stage positivity concerns its duration.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D113","name":"PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace","meaning":"Extracts the uniform structure associated with a pseudometric.","effect_on_target":"Carries the usual real metric into the topology used by integrability.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D114","name":"RCLike.toInnerProductSpaceReal","meaning":"The real inner-product structure on a real-or-complex-like scalar field.","effect_on_target":"Here it equips Real itself with its standard real normed-space structure.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D115","name":"Real","meaning":"The real numbers.","effect_on_target":"States, times, volumes, errors, eigenvalues, and coordinate locations are real.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D116","name":"Real.instAdd","meaning":"Real addition.","effect_on_target":"Combines scalar errors and coefficients.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D117","name":"Real.instAddCommGroup","meaning":"The usual additive abelian group of real numbers.","effect_on_target":"Underlies vector subtraction and addition.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D118","name":"Real.instAddCommMonoid","meaning":"Real addition with zero.","effect_on_target":"Underlies finite sums and module structures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D119","name":"Real.instCommSemiring","meaning":"Usual real addition and commutative multiplication with zero and one.","effect_on_target":"Supplies scalar arithmetic without adding hypotheses.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D120","name":"Real.instDivInvMonoid","meaning":"Real division is multiplication by the totalized inverse.","effect_on_target":"Update ratios have their ordinary meaning because relevant cell volumes are positive.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D121","name":"Real.instLE","meaning":"The usual non-strict order on reals.","effect_on_target":"Interprets all error upper bounds.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D122","name":"Real.instLT","meaning":"The usual strict order on reals.","effect_on_target":"Interprets positive durations and positive grid widths.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D123","name":"Real.instMul","meaning":"Real multiplication.","effect_on_target":"Forms products of widths and error coefficients.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D124","name":"Real.instRCLike","meaning":"Real numbers viewed as an RCLike field with identity real part and zero imaginary part.","effect_on_target":"Analysis remains entirely over real scalars; complex eigenvalues are not introduced.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D125","name":"Real.instRing","meaning":"The ordinary real ring structure.","effect_on_target":"Supports state-space algebra.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D126","name":"Real.instSub","meaning":"Real subtraction as addition of the negative.","effect_on_target":"Defines widths and scalar differences.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D127","name":"Real.instZero","meaning":"The real number zero.","effect_on_target":"Sets each stage reference's initial time and positivity threshold.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D128","name":"Real.measureSpace","meaning":"The standard real measurable space with Lebesgue measure.","effect_on_target":"All interval integrals and Cartesian volume products use Lebesgue measure.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D129","name":"Real.normedAddCommGroup","meaning":"Real addition with absolute-value norm and usual metric.","effect_on_target":"Component norms are absolute values.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D130","name":"Real.normedCommRing","meaning":"The usual real commutative ring with absolute-value norm.","effect_on_target":"Determines the component norm underlying the product error norm.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D131","name":"Real.normedField","meaning":"The real field with absolute-value norm and inverse of zero equal to zero.","effect_on_target":"Supplies real normed-space and division semantics.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D132","name":"Real.pseudoMetricSpace","meaning":"Distance between reals is |x-y|.","effect_on_target":"Fixes the usual real topology.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D133","name":"Real.semiring","meaning":"The ordinary semiring operations on reals.","effect_on_target":"Supports pointwise real module structures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D134","name":"Ring.toSemiring","meaning":"Forgets additive inverses from the bundled ring structure.","effect_on_target":"Preserves underlying real operations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D135","name":"SeminormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddGroup","meaning":"Forgets additive commutativity while retaining norm and metric.","effect_on_target":"An analysis instance conversion with no changed norm.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D136","name":"SeminormedAddGroup.toContinuousENorm","meaning":"Views a finite nonnegative norm as a continuous extended nonnegative norm.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the norm used in integrability requirements.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D137","name":"SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing","meaning":"Forgets the unit while retaining norm and ring operations.","effect_on_target":"Preserves real component norms in integration instances.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D138","name":"Semiring.toNonUnitalSemiring","meaning":"Forgets the multiplicative unit from the structure.","effect_on_target":"Preserves scalar addition and multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D139","name":"Set","meaning":"A predicate on a type.","effect_on_target":"Admissibility and spatial regions are arbitrary subsets with the separately specified constraints.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D140","name":"Set.instMembership","meaning":"Membership means satisfaction of the set predicate.","effect_on_target":"Interprets all admissible-state and region conditions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D141","name":"Subtype","meaning":"Elements of a type satisfying a predicate.","effect_on_target":"Transverse coordinates are indexed by directions unequal to d.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D142","name":"Subtype.fintype","meaning":"Enumerates the elements of a finite type satisfying a decidable predicate.","effect_on_target":"Makes the transverse coordinate product finite.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D143","name":"TopologicalSpace","meaning":"A topology on a type.","effect_on_target":"Point has a topology used for adjacent-cell closure incidence.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D144","name":"UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace","meaning":"Extracts the topology associated with a uniform structure.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the usual real topology to state-space products.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D145","name":"Zero.toOfNat0","meaning":"Interprets numeral 0 as the chosen zero element.","effect_on_target":"The reference interval starts at real zero.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D146","name":"instDecidableNot","meaning":"Decidability of a proposition gives decidability of its negation.","effect_on_target":"Allows enumeration of directions distinct from d.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D147","name":"instHAdd","meaning":"Uses homogeneous addition for overloaded addition.","effect_on_target":"Selects ordinary integer or real addition.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D148","name":"instHAppendOfAppend","meaning":"Uses ordinary append for overloaded append.","effect_on_target":"Selects list concatenation in stage decomposition.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D149","name":"instHDiv","meaning":"Uses homogeneous division for overloaded division.","effect_on_target":"Selects ordinary real division.","status":"understood"},

  "translation": {
    "binders": [
      "Universally quantify a finite type D with decidable equality, a natural number m, a type Point with a measurable space and a topology, and a type FacePoint with a measurable space. Put E=R^{Fin m} and C=Z^D. E has componentwise vector operations and the maximum norm.",
      "Universally quantify data of type LocalDef011 D Point FacePoint m, containing the partition, measures, face sampling maps, admissible sets, normal fluxes, and structural constraints described below.",
      "Universally quantify rule:D×C×R×(Z→E)→E and admitted:D×C×R×(Z→E)→Prop. The numerical rule receives a direction, a face's right-hand cell index, a duration, and an entire integer-indexed state line.",
      "Universally quantify a finite ordered list stages of pairs (d,h) in D×R, an initial state initial:C→E, references reference:List(D×R)×D×R→(Point×R→E), and real error functions oldError and faceError on List(D×R)×D×R×C.",
      "Stage assertions quantify every prefix before, direction d, real h, and suffix after satisfying stages=before++[(d,h)]++after. For such an occurrence, current is defined, not chosen, as the evolution through before from initial. The associated reference and errors depend on before,d,h and the cell where applicable; they have no separate suffix argument.",
      "The final conditional clause universally quantifies axes:D→LocalDef022 and lineRule:D×C×R×(Z→E)→E. Within it, the line identity quantifies every direction, real duration, full lattice state, and base cell. The lifted balance quantifies every direction, flux:E→E, q:R×R→E satisfying the stated rectangle law, and all real s,t."
    ],
    "hypotheses": [
      "m>0.",
      "Structural data assumptions: there is a domain Ω⊆Point and a family of measurable pairwise disjoint cell regions R_c, c∈C, whose union is exactly Ω. The cell index type is inhabited. A measure μ on Point satisfies 0<μ(R_c)<∞ for every c. Write V_c=μ(R_c).toReal, so V_c>0.",
      "Structural face assumptions: for each d,c there is a measure ν_{d,c} on FacePoint and a sampling map p_{d,c}:FacePoint→Point. Every p_{d,c}(z) lies in both closure(R_{c[d:=c_d-1]}) and closure(R_c). There is a set S_d⊆E and a normal flux N_{d,c,z}:E→E.",
      "Structural derivative assumption: for every d,c,z and v∈S_d, there exists a continuous real-linear map L:E→E with N_{d,c,z}(v+w)=N_{d,c,z}(v)+L(w)+o(||w||) as w→0 in the full state space. There then exist real numbers λ_i and a real basis (b_i)_{i∈Fin m} of E such that the standard-coordinate matrix of L satisfies L b_i=λ_i b_i for every i. These witnesses may depend on d,c,z,v.",
      "Constant-line assumption: for every d,c,h and v∈E, if h>0, v∈S_d, and admitted(d,c,h,j↦v), then z↦N_{d,c,z}(v) is ν_{d,c}-integrable and rule(d,c,h,j↦v)=∫N_{d,c,z}(v)dν_{d,c}(z).",
      "stages is nonempty; for every d∈D there exists a real h such that (d,h) occurs in stages; every occurring pair has h>0. The covering witness h can depend on d.",
      "For every stage decomposition, put u=current and q=reference(before,d,h). For every τ∈[0,h], q(·,τ) is μ-integrable on every R_c, z↦N_{d,c,z}(q(p_{d,c}(z),τ)) is ν_{d,c}-integrable for every c, q(p_{d,c}(z),τ)∈S_d for every c,z, and q(x,τ)∈S_d for every x∈Ω.",
      "For each such reference, define M_q(c,τ)=V_c^{-1}∫_{R_c}q(x,τ)dμ(x) and P_{d,q}(c,τ)=∫N_{d,c,z}(q(p_{d,c}(z),τ))dν_{d,c}(z). Each P_{d,q}(c,·) is interval integrable from 0 to h, and V_c(M_q(c,h)-M_q(c,0))=∫_0^h[P_{d,q}(c,τ)-P_{d,q}(c[d:=c_d+1],τ)]dτ for every c.",
      "For every stage decomposition and cell c, admitted(d,c,h,j↦u(c[d:=j])) and u(c)∈S_d.",
      "For every stage decomposition and cell c, ||u(c)-M_q(c,0)||∞≤oldError(before,d,h,c).",
      "For every stage decomposition and cell c, ||F_{d,h,u}(c)-h^{-1}∫_0^h P_{d,q}(c,τ)dτ||∞≤faceError(before,d,h,c), with F defined below."
    ],
    "conclusions": [
      "All the following statements hold jointly: m>0; every normal flux has the statewise real-diagonalizable Fréchet derivative property on S_d described above; the entire conditional constant-line integrability and equality assumption holds again; stages is nonempty; and every direction occurs in stages.",
      "For every decomposition stages=before++[(d,h)]++after, with u=Evolution(before,initial), h>0, reference(before,d,h) satisfies every reference condition above on [0,h], every line j↦u(c[d:=j]) is admitted at its corresponding d,c,h, and every current cell value belongs to S_d.",
      "For each such decomposition, Evolution(stages,initial)=Evolution(after,T_{d,h}(u)) as entire lattice states.",
      "For each such decomposition and every cell c, V_c T_{d,h}(u)(c)=V_c u(c)-h[F_{d,h,u}(c[d:=c_d+1])-F_{d,h,u}(c)].",
      "For each such decomposition, every base b∈C, every start a∈Z, and every count n∈N, let c_k=b[d:=a+k]. Then Σ_{k=0}^{n-1}V_{c_k}T_{d,h}(u)(c_k)=Σ_{k=0}^{n-1}V_{c_k}u(c_k)-h[F_{d,h,u}(b[d:=a+n])-F_{d,h,u}(b[d:=a])]. The sums are vector sums and the identity includes n=0.",
      "For each such decomposition, every other:C→E and base b∈C, if u(b[d:=j])=other(b[d:=j]) for every integer j, then T_{d,h}(u)(b[d:=j])=T_{d,h}(other)(b[d:=j]) for every integer j. The other state need not satisfy admissibility assumptions.",
      "For each such decomposition, q=reference(before,d,h), and every c, ||T_{d,h}(u)(c)-M_q(c,h)||∞≤oldError(before,d,h,c)+(h/V_c)[faceError(before,d,h,c)+faceError(before,d,h,c[d:=c_d+1])].",
